parsed.name: 安全缓冲区访问组件
parsed.description: 一种非物理软件组件，用于在线程安全条件下读写与 PLC/Modbus 相关的输入、输出和内存缓冲区。它支持布尔、字节、16/32/64 位整数、批量读写、变量调试访问以及配置读取，常用于实验自动化程序中的共享数据交换与控制逻辑集成。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component for thread-safe reading and writing of PLC/Modbus-related input, output, and memory buffers. It supports boolean, byte, 16/32/64-bit integers, batch operations, variable inspection, and configuration access, and is commonly used for shared data exchange and control-logic integration in laboratory automation software.
